legal_immigration_level: The US should give out 2 million or more green cards a year, about double today.

The US should keep giving out about 1 million green cards a year.

The US should cut green cards to fewer than 250,000 a year.

The US should admit somewhat more seasonal temporary workers.
The US should admit about as many seasonal temporary workers as today.
The US should admit somewhat fewer seasonal temporary workers.
The US should admit many fewer seasonal temporary workers.
temp_workers_skilled: The US should admit many more skilled temporary workers, like engineers and programmers, than today.
The US should admit somewhat more skilled temporary workers.
The US should admit about as many skilled temporary workers as today.
The US should admit somewhat fewer skilled temporary workers.
The US should admit many fewer skilled temporary workers.
skills_vs_family: Green cards should go mostly to people with family ties here, as now.
Green cards should be split about evenly between family ties and job skills.
Green cards should go mostly to people chosen for job skills and education.
sponsor_relatives: Citizens should be able to sponsor spouses, children, parents and siblings, with shorter waits than today.
Citizens should be able to sponsor spouses, children, parents and siblings, as now.
Citizens should be able to sponsor only spouses, minor children and parents, not siblings or adult children.
Citizens should be able to sponsor only spouses and minor children.
status_policy: Most people here without legal status should be able to stay and become citizens without major penalties.
They should be able to stay and become citizens after paying a fine and passing a background check.
They should be able to stay and work legally, but not become citizens.
They should be able to work here for a limited time, then have to leave.
They should be required to leave, starting with people with criminal records.
All of them should be removed as quickly as possible.

border_security: The southern border should have fewer agents and barriers than today.
Border enforcement should stay about where it is.
The border should get more agents and technology, but no new physical wall.
There should be a wall along most of the southern border, plus more agents.
military_border: The military shouldn't be used at the border; civilian agencies should handle border control.
Troops can help border agents with transport and surveillance, but shouldn't stop people themselves.
Troops should stop people crossing without permission and turn them back.
everify: Employers shouldn't be required to check electronically that new hires can legally work.
Only large employers should have to use E-Verify.
All employers should have to use E-Verify, with heavy fines for hiring people without legal status.
local_police_cooperation: Local police shouldn't help federal immigration agents at all.
Local police should help federal agents only with people convicted of serious crimes.
Local police should help federal immigration agents whenever asked.
asylum_rules: Applying for asylum should be easier, and applicants should be able to live and work here while they wait.
People should keep the right to apply for asylum here, but cases should be decided much faster.
People should have to apply for asylum from outside the US, or in the first safe country they reach.
Asylum at the southern border should end or be sharply limited.
asylum_grounds: People fleeing gang violence or domestic abuse should qualify for asylum, even if their own government could protect them.
They should qualify only if their own government can't or won't protect them.
Asylum should be only for people targeted for their race, religion, politics or similar reasons, not gang violence or domestic abuse.
refugee_cap: The US should resettle 125,000 or more refugees a year.
The US should resettle about 50,000 to 100,000 refugees a year.
The US should resettle about 15,000 to 30,000 refugees a year.
The US should resettle fewer than 10,000 refugees a year.
The US shouldn't resettle any refugees.
birthright_citizenship: Every child born in the US should automatically be a citizen, whatever their parents' status.
A child born here should be a citizen only if a parent is a citizen or a green card holder.
A child born here should be a citizen only if a parent is a citizen.
assimilation: Immigrants shouldn't be expected to adopt American customs; they can keep their own if they wish.
Immigrants should learn English and follow the law, and otherwise keep their own culture freely.
Immigrants should learn English and adopt most American customs.
Immigrants should fully blend in and leave their old customs behind.

american_basis: Anyone who believes in the country's ideals, like freedom and equality, can become American.

patriotic_education: Schools should give the country's failures and injustices at least as much attention as its achievements.

Schools should emphasize the country's achievements and ideals so students take pride in it.
anthem_kneeling: Kneeling during the national anthem is always an acceptable protest.
